blocks.text: PATIENT: Jane Doe (PAT-883910). Orthopedic surgery consultation for chronic right knee pain.
Assessment: Severe osteoarthritis of right knee, primary (M17.11), confirmed on imaging.
History: Patient completed two physical therapy  sessions and has been on Ibuprofen 600mg TID with minimal symptom improvement.
Plan: Proceeding with Total Knee Arthroplasty, right knee. Arthroplasty, knee, condyle and plateau; medial AND lateral compartments.
Current medications: Eliquis 5mg BID for atrial fibrillation. New post-operative prescription: Toradol 10mg QID PRN pain control.
